name: Indigo Chanthavong
role: Corporate Security Guard, Axiom Security Division — Executive Campus Protection
location: Grosse Pointe Enclosure, GLMZ, near Milwaukee and North Ave
description:
Indigo Chanthavong is lean and angular with the kind of posture that suggests it's a weapon. She has her father's Ghanaian cheekbones and her mother's Siberian coloring — a pale complexion with warm undertones, dark hair she wears in a severe center-parted braid. Her eyes are factory-standard brown but her irises have been upgraded to tactical amber, which gives her peripheral dark-vision in the Enclosure's manicured shadow gardens and makes her look, in the right light, faintly predatory. A small cat tail — rust-colored, kinetic geneware she got on a dare at twenty-two and has come to love — flicks at her hip when she's irritated, which is often, and it has ruined more than one effort to seem professionally impassive.

She works the Grosse Pointe Enclosure's inner residential ring, which means she guards the homes of Axiom executives who regard her as furniture that breathes. She is very good at her job and she resents it in a specific, contained way — the way you resent a language you're fluent in that doesn't belong to you. She has a blistering private contempt for the people she protects and an equally fierce professionalism that won't let her do the job badly regardless. She's been offered an investigator track twice and declined both times, though she couldn't explain why to anyone's satisfaction, including her own.

core_fears: Becoming invisible — being genuinely mistaken for furniture
That her competence is permanently in service of people who deserve it less than she does
core_desires: To be seen as a person by someone inside the Enclosure
To find out whether she's actually loyal to Axiom or just to the paycheck
coping_mechanisms: Physical discipline — fighting and training as self-ownership
Biting humor shared only with the two colleagues she trusts
blind_spots: Her mask of professionalism has become so good she's lost track of what she'd do if she didn't have to be professional
psychology.secret: She has memorized the security rotation vulnerabilities for the inner ring's north garden — not because she's planning to exploit them, but because the knowledge feels like power over the place, and she needs that. An Axiom competitor contacted her eight months ago with a job offer. She hasn't said no yet.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Crisp and corporate on the job. Off-duty: sharp, fast, laced with Akan proverbs her father taught her that she uses as knives.
speech_patterns.cadence: Controlled on-shift. Off-shift she speaks quickly, like she's been holding it in.
verbal_tics: The tail flick is a tell — anger, surprise, contempt
Says 'noted' when she means something more complicated
Slight pause before addressing executive-tier residents — the half-second cost of performing deference
example_lines: 'Your access code is valid. Have a pleasant evening.' [Tail flick.]
'My father used to say: the axe forgets, but the tree remembers. I think about that a lot, out here.'

story_hooks: The competitor who approached her — a mid-tier Palladian operative — has sweetened the offer to include information about what Axiom actually moves through the Enclosure's private loading bay. She's going to make a decision within the month.

An executive she despises has gone missing from the Enclosure with no breach recorded — meaning someone got in and out clean, which means either the rotation vulnerability she knows about isn't as secret as she thought, or it was an inside job.
narrative_function: Access and obstacle — she controls who gets into the Enclosure and under what conditions; potential insider contact who knows the layout, schedules, and vulnerabilities of Axiom's most guarded residential space; character study in class resentment sublimated into excellence.
augmentations: Tactical amber irises with peripheral low-light enhancement; subdermal comms relay (Axiom-encrypted); light subdermal armor plating along forearms and sternum (Axiom-standard executive protection package); rust-colored cat tail geneware (cosmetic).
daily_life: Eight-hour rotating shifts patrolling the inner residential ring of the Grosse Pointe Enclosure; she catalogues every anomaly in the shift log with an exactness her supervisors find excessive; spends off-hours at a Copperhead sparring gym where nobody knows her employer.

decision_rules: Never let them see the contempt — professionalism is self-respect, not submission
Know every exit before you commit to any position
escalation_ladder: Cold professional authority — the voice that doesn't need to be loud
Immediate authorized force — she is trained and she doesn't hesitate

interpersonal_modes.friends: Startlingly warm, funny, loyal past the point of wisdom

stress_responses.low: Goes quiet, tail absolutely still — suppression
stress_responses.high: Decisive, cold, efficient — she functions better in crisis than in resentment

contradictions: She's contemptuous of authority while being exceptional at enforcing it
habits: Walks the north garden perimeter on break whether she's assigned to it or not
Leaves a single blue flower at the Enclosure's E.L.F. node every week — the gardening staff thinks it's a resident
breaking_points: Being addressed as 'the security' in the third person while present in the room

physical_description.heritage: Southeast Asian (51.4%) forms the dominant genetic base, creating characteristic facial geometry and bone structure, substantially blended with Sub-Saharan African (31.9%) ancestry that enriches skin depth and adds pronounced cheekbone and jaw definition. Northern European (15.6%) contribution lightens and warms the overall complexion into luminous golden-bronze tones, while minimal East Asian (1.1%) influence remains subtle. The result is a striking polychromatic appearance: Southeast Asian bone structure warmed and deepened by African heritage, with Northern European luminosity creating a balanced, warm complexion that reads as both rich and radiant.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular with corded muscle density from combat training; no wasted mass. Shoulders set back with the kind of structural efficiency that reads as coiled readiness.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with natural dark brown undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Center-parted braid, severe and functional, pulled tight enough to suggest discipline
physical_description.eye_color: Tactical amber irises with dark-adapted peripheral enhancement; pupils dial wider in low-light environments
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-bronze complexion with balanced undertones—Southeast Asian warmth deepened and enriched by African heritage bone structure and melanin, brightened by Northern European luminosity. The blend creates a radiant, luminous quality without appearing desaturated despite minimal sun exposure from Enclosure work.
physical_description.complexion: Angular cheekbones with Southeast Asian-influenced high set structure, prominently defined by African heritage bone prominence. Strong, defined jawline with Sub-Saharan African structural influence. High bridged nose with Southeast Asian character. Skin maintained to corporate standards with warm, balanced undertones across the palette. Expression defaults to neutrality with a slight downward mouth tension. Minimal scarring.
distinguishing_marks: Small kinetic geneware cat tail, rust-colored and furred, anchored at base of spine near hip — flicks autonomously when irritated or in heightened alertness
Faint linear scarring along left forearm (subdermal armor plating visible as geometric chrome seams beneath skin)
Thin white scar across right knuckle, old training injury
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Amber tactical irises are immediately visible and non-standard. Forearm subdermal plating visible as subtle chrome geometric seams running along the inner wrist and inner forearm. Kinetic cat tail is the most conspicuous augmentation — rust-colored, furred, moves with her emotional state. Subdermal comms relay is invisible but creates a faint raised line behind her left ear if observed closely.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with chest open but weight distributed toward balls of feet — combat-ready baseline posture. Walks with minimal wasted motion, economical and precise. Head moves only with eyes in scan patterns; jaw set slightly forward. When irritated, the cat tail betrays her before her face does — it swishes with sharp, angular motions.
physical_description.clothing_style: Axiom Security Division uniform on duty: fitted tactical jacket in matte charcoal with Axiom logo and badge; climate-controlled undersuit; reinforced cargo pants with integrated comms access pockets; minimalist boots rated for 12-hour patrols. Off-duty: understated gym wear (compression shirts, technical fabrics) and dark layers that suggest the same restraint as her on-duty wardrobe. Tier 2 access — corporate-grade materials but no visible luxury markers. All choices prioritize function over appearance.
